preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 2*10**5 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('1')])
preconditions.description: Each test case has n vertices, where n is an integer between 2 and 2*10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 3 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('1'))
preconditions.description: Each edge description line contains exactly three integers: p_j, a_j, b_j.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(p_j) <= n and 1 <= int(a_j) <= 10**9 and 1 <= int(b_j) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('1') for p_j, a_j, b_j in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: For each edge, p_j is the parent vertex (1 ≤ p_j ≤ n), and a_j, b_j are positive integers (1 ≤ a_j, b_j ≤ 10^9).

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= j <= n for j in range(2, n+1) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('1'))
preconditions.description: Each edge description corresponds to a vertex j from 2 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == n-1 for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line contains exactly n-1 integers, corresponding to r_2, r_3, ..., r_n.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(r_i) <= path_length for r_i, path_length in zip(output_line.split(), [len(path) for path in paths]) if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each vertex i (2 ≤ i ≤ n), r_i is a non-negative integer not exceeding the length of the path from root to i.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(a_j for a_j, _ in path) == A_i and sum(b_j for _, b_j in path[:r_i+1]) <= A_i and (r_i == len(path) or sum(b_j for _, b_j in path[:r_i+2]) > A_i) for i, path, A_i, r_i in zip(range(2, n+1), paths, [sum(a_j for a_j, _ in path) for path in paths], [int(r_i) for r_i in output_line.split()]) if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each vertex i (2 ≤ i ≤ n), r_i is the length of the maximum prefix of the path from root to i such that the sum of b_j along this prefix does not exceed A_i (the sum of a_j along the entire path).
